# Mask folder-state flags on message-header read and write boundaries

RuntimeOnly includes Elided, New and Offline specifically for X-Mozilla-Status/X-Mozilla-Status2 persistence. Current compaction, patching and parsing strip this mask. Preserve both read and write boundaries so old files do not restore these folder-state bits. The name RuntimeOnly here does not establish that these flags can never be stored in any database. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mailnews/base/public.
